method: Read-only database transaction plus closed-run event pages and business-note files. No raw results modified.

compression_trace_records.termination_reason: task_boundary_context_swap_deferred; summary state retained in history_chunks

limits: Settled native transcript pages prove persisted native dialogue, not that all agents' model prompts were captured or that every turn was summarized.
Inspection pages use the official redacted diagnostic representation. Full page coverage counts message positions and does not imply unredacted or untruncated message strings.
Ready chunks prove persisted summaries. Applied traces distinguish summary replacement from forced fallback folding; ready alone does not prove a context swap.
Business-note numbers are narrowly labelled stored claims. Missing extracted values do not imply missing note content; hashes permit independent verification.
The last persisted LLM exchange is not proof that no later untraced exchange ran. This run may have a separate contract-checker callback coverage gap.
Terminal status and graceful shutdown are independent. A cancelled task remains cancelled; same-Session continuation must be assessed from its own later task evidence.
